notes: Producent (ikona slúchadiel v lište Aranžmánu): rozoberie pieseň a navrhne zlepšenia – každý si vypočuješ, prepneš A/B a prijmeš alebo zahodíš. Verzie piesne (ikona vetvy): skús viac nápadov ako vetvy, prepínaj aj počas hrania a preber časť z inej verzie. Zvuk napodobený ústami: nahraj zvuk do audio stopy a v Nauč sa zvuk ho vyber – Inspiria z neho spraví syntezátor. Krivka energie: pri nízkej energii redšie bicie, filter Inspirie sa privrie, tlačidlom ju úplne vypneš.
notes_en: Producer (headphones icon in the Arrangement bar): analyses the song and suggests improvements – hear each one, switch A/B, accept or discard. Song versions (branch icon): try several ideas as branches, switch even while playing and take a part from another version. Mouth-imitated sound: record a sound into an audio track and pick it in Learn sound – Inspiria turns it into a synth. Energy curve: sparser drums and a darker Inspiria filter at low energy; the button turns it off completely.
